changeSet.author: mini-core
changeSet.comment: Skip outbox row when only balances changed (balances are not synced to Digital Twin)
changeSet.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION minicore.fn_outbox_accounts() RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$ BEGIN IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' THEN -- Skip if only balances (and updated_at) changed IF OLD.account_number IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.account_number AND OLD.product_type IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.product_type AND OLD.status IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.status AND OLD.currency_code IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.currency_code AND OLD.created_by IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.created_by THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
-- Pre-update snapshot INSERT INTO minicore.outbox_accounts (operation_type, snapshot_type, account_id, account_number, product_type, status, available_balance, collected_balance, currency_code, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ('UPDATE', 'PRE', OLD.account_id, OLD.account_number, OLD.product_type, OLD.status, OLD.available_balance, OLD.collected_balance, OLD.currency_code, OLD.created_by, OLD.created_at, OLD.updated_at); -- Post-update snapshot INSERT INTO minicore.outbox_accounts (operation_type, snapshot_type, account_id, account_number, product_type, status, available_balance, collected_balance, currency_code, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ('UPDATE', 'POS', NEW.account_id, NEW.account_number, NEW.product_type, NEW.status, NEW.available_balance, NEW.collected_balance, NEW.currency_code, NEW.created_by, NEW.created_at, NEW.updated_at); ELSE -- INSERT: only post snapshot INSERT INTO minicore.outbox_accounts (operation_type, snapshot_type, account_id, account_number, product_type, status, available_balance, collected_balance, currency_code, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ('INSERT', 'POS', NEW.account_id, NEW.account_number, NEW.product_type, NEW.status, NEW.available_balance, NEW.collected_balance, NEW.currency_code, NEW.created_by, NEW.created_at, NEW.updated_at); END IF; RETURN NEW; END; $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql
